features.title: FastAPI/React skeleton with health endpoint
acceptance: Backend starts on port 8000 with /health endpoint returning JSON
Frontend builds with Vite and serves on port 5173
Docker Compose brings up backend + frontend + Keycloak
Backend pytest passes, frontend npm test passes

features.title: Agent workflow orchestration engine
acceptance: POST /api/workflows creates a workflow run with provider-qualified reviewers
GET /api/workflows/{id} returns status and collected reviews
Cross-provider dispatch: claude -> codex exec, codex -> claude -p
Incomplete verdict when any reviewer fails

features.title: Hook effectiveness measurement from transcripts
acceptance: Compute opens per 100 prompts for main vs subagent

features.title: OIDC Keycloak authentication with SPA PKCE
acceptance: Login redirects to Keycloak, callback exchanges code for tokens
Tokens kept in memory (sessionStorage for verifier/state)
